items.title: PVP: Midnight Warrior
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Up your game with this strategic PvP texture pack. From short swords and small shields, to custom particles and outlined blocks, this pack will help you get the upper ground and claim victory over your enemies!

- Custom paintings
- Short swords
- Low fire
- Outlined ore & wool
- Potion specific particle effects
- Clear glass
- And much much more!
items.changelog:
New update! Particles are back, all the latest textures, and minor improvements!
Servers can opt to disable client-side particles. However, you are still responsible for checking and following rules—violations could lead to permabans.
